login.title: Welcome to the Bestim dashboard
login.hint: Sign in with your app account. Admins only.
login.resetDone: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.
login.notAdmin: This account is not allowed into the dashboard.
login.panelText: Users, cars, records and AI usage in one place.
login.auditNote: Opening any user's page is written to the audit log.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.hint: Enter your account email. We'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way. Open it in this same browser.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.short: The password must be at least 8 characters.
reset.expired: This link has expired or was opened in a different browser. Request a new one and open it in the same browser.

overview.title: Overview
overview.costNote: An estimate from the average cost per call. The real number is on the Google bill.

users.title: Users and admins
users.name: Name
users.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Give it to them privately; they can change it with Forgot password.
users.rolesHint: Owner: everything, including who is an admin. Admin: manage users and content. Viewer: look only.
users.pickUser: Search a user by name or email
users.noMatch: No user found, or they are already an admin.
users.removeNote: Their account stays and works in the app. They only lose access to this dashboard.
users.ownerOnly: Only an owner can add, change or remove admins.
users.deleteWarn: This deletes the account and all their cars and records for good. It cannot be undone. If you are not sure, use Suspend instead.

err.noKey: The server key is not set up yet (SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY on Vercel).
err.name: Enter a name (up to 80 characters).
err.password: The password must be 8 to 72 characters.
err.emailTaken: This email already has an account.
err.invalid: Something in the form is not valid.
err.save: Something went wrong and it wasn't saved. Try again.
err.lastOwner: There must always be at least one owner.
err.self: You can't do this to your own account.
err.isAdmin: This person is an admin. Remove their admin access first.
err.confirm: The email you typed doesn't match.

user.auditNote: Opening this page is written to the audit log.
user.planFailed: Couldn't save the plan. Try again.

catalog.viewOnly: View only: your account can't make changes.
catalog.deleteHint: Deleting is permanent. If you are not sure, hide it with the "Shown in the app" switch instead.

err.name: Enter the name in Arabic and in English (up to 60 characters).
err.number: The number must be a whole number, not negative.
err.fields: Too many or too long extra fields (up to 20 fields, 40 characters each).
err.imgType: The picture must be PNG, WebP or JPEG.
err.imgBig: The picture is bigger than 2 MB.
err.upload: We couldn't upload the picture, try again.
err.dup: Something with the same English name already exists.
err.save: Something went wrong and it wasn't saved. Try again.
err.hasModels: This brand still has models. Delete the models first or hide the brand.
err.inUse: This part is used in records. Hide it instead of deleting it.
err.planId: ID: lowercase English letters, digits and _ only, 2 to 20 characters, starting with a letter.
err.planName: Enter the name in Arabic and English (up to 40 characters) and descriptions (up to 200).
err.planMax: You have reached the limit: 3 plans.
err.planDefault: There must always be one default plan. Make another plan the default first.
err.planInUse: Users are on this plan. Move them to another plan or hide it instead of deleting.
err.pageText: Enter a title in both languages (up to 80 characters). Each text can be up to 60,000 characters.
err.planPopular: Only one plan can have the "Most popular" badge.

cars.title: Cars
cars.noModels: This brand has no models yet.
cars.logoNote: Square logo, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB. Without one we show the first letter.
cars.modelNote: Transparent PNG, about 1000 x 500, car seen from the side, up to 2 MB. Without a picture the app uses the car type's picture.

parts.title: Parts and services
parts.sub: Every part has 3 pictures: fine, due soon, overdue
parts.picsNote: Choose a new picture under any slot to replace it. WebP or transparent PNG, about 400 x 400, up to 2 MB.
parts.reminder: Remind the customer when it is due
parts.fieldsNote: Separate with commas, for example: Brand, Notes

types.title: Car types
types.sub: This picture shows for any car that has no picture of its own
types.info: You can edit names and pictures, and hide a type. Adding a new type needs an app update, so it isn't possible here.
types.note: Transparent PNG, about 1000 x 500, car seen from the side, up to 2 MB.

plans.title: Plans
plans.info: The default plan applies to everyone without a plan of their own. An empty limit means no limit from the plan.
plans.maxHint: You have 3 plans: delete one or edit an existing one.
plans.idHint: Lowercase English letters, digits and _, 2 to 20 characters. It cannot be changed later.
plans.blankNote: Leave a limit empty = no limit from the plan.
plans.saved: Saved. The app and the website follow these settings now.
plans.modalNote: Names, prices, limits and switches are edited in the table on the main page.
plans.priceHint: Empty = not priced yet: the app and website say "Coming soon". 0 = free.

group.limits: Limits (a number, or empty for no limit)
group.coming: Proposed features (saved, but the app doesn't use them yet)

plans.lockTitle: When a plan doesn't include it
plans.lockHide: Hide it completely (otherwise it shows locked with a Subscribe button)

pages.title: Pages
pages.sub: Privacy, terms and other pages shown in the app and on the website
pages.info: Changes show on the website straight away and in the app the next time it opens the page. Write each page in both languages.
pages.bodyHint: Start a section with ## then its heading. Leave a blank line between paragraphs. Start a line with - for a list item.

team.unavailable: We couldn't load the team data right now. The database may not be updated yet. Try again later.

err.readonly: Your account is read only and can't make changes.
err.unavailable: We couldn't save right now. Try again.
err.title: Enter a title (up to 200 characters).
err.long: One of the texts is too long (short fields 120 characters, long texts 10,000).
err.link: The linked task number isn't valid.
err.invalid: One of the values was refused (for example a task number that doesn't exist).
err.fileType: The file must be an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP or HEIC), a video (MP4 or MOV) or a PDF.
err.fileBig: The file is bigger than 10 MB.
err.upload: We couldn't upload the file. Try again.

overview.title: Team
overview.sub: Bugs and tasks in one place
overview.goTasksSub: What needs doing and who owns it
overview.newTaskSub: Add a task for someone on the team

form.linkHint: Enter the number of an existing task (for example 12) to link this bug to it.

item.fileHint: Up to 10 MB: images, video or PDF.

connect.title: Connect Claude
connect.intro: Connect Claude to the team board so it can file and update bugs and tasks for you. You make your own key below; it acts as you, so keep it private.
connect.urlLabel: Connector address (add your key at the end)
connect.keyHelp: A key is like a password. It is shown once. If it leaks, revoke it and make a new one. Anyone with it can read and change the team board as you.
connect.keyNew: Your new key (copy it now, it won't be shown again)
connect.keyFull: Full connector address with your key
connect.keyError: We couldn't make a key. Try again.
stepsDesktop: Paste the full connector address with your key and save.
stepsWeb: Open claude.ai, then Settings, then Connectors.
Paste the full connector address with your key and save.
stepsCode: Create your key above, then run the command with your key in your terminal.
Inside Claude Code type /mcp to check that bestim-team is connected.
abilities: List bugs and tasks with filters
Read one item with its comments and files
Create a bug with steps, expected and actual
Create a task with an owner and due date
Update the status or any field
